name: io.github.kiet0807/taiga-mcp
description: Sprints, stories, tasks, issues, epics, wiki and attached files in Taiga; writes only when allowed.

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of the Taiga API host, e.g. https://api.taiga.io

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A Taiga token, instead of username and password

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: true lets the AI create, change and comment on items (off by default; nothing can be deleted)
